text:
maya_cs: Hey team — async standup for CobaltHealth renewal. Quick: what you did / blockers / today? Main blockers: embedding webhook 502s, renewal call next Tue. I'm collecting notes for the account owner.

ryan_eng: Did a quick hotfix to the embedding worker to handle timeouts and added exponential backoff. Opened PR #582. Still seeing some 502s in the tail.

lena_support: Spoke w/ CobaltHealth PM at 09:30. They see 502s on batch uploads and occasional duplicate embeddings. Provided temp workaround (retry on 4xx/5xx). They're nervous about renewal — asked for ETA on fix.

oliver_sre: Deployed a canary of ryan's PR to staging at 10:05. Watching error rate. Added extra logging for request id and KV cache hits.

ryan_eng: PTAL @oliver_sre — PR 582 changes: add idempotency token + backoff loop. Snippet:
```
for attempt in range(3):
  resp = send_batch()
  if resp.status < 500: break
  sleep(2**attempt)
```

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded to staging: deploy-2024-11-20T10:06Z :white_check_mark:

lena_support: :eyes: logs show a handful of 502s with `kvcache_miss=true` and long tail latency (~1.2s token). Might be related to cache regen + cold starts.

maya_cs: OK — plan: 1) Ryan to finish CR + push canary to prod small pool 2) Oliver to set alert if 502 rate > 0.5% 3) Lena to update CobaltHealth with ETA and temp workaround. Can we target prod canary by EOD? @ryan_eng @oliver_sre

ryan_eng: I'll get the CR addressed today, aim for prod canary by 17:00 PT. Tagging PR with `cs/urgent`.

oliver_sre: I'll add the alert and a short runbook snippet. If we see >0.5% 502s for 5m, auto-fallback to older model variant. Adding Kibana dashboard now.

maya_cs: Thanks. If anything blocks rollout, ping me immediately and I'll notify the AE and renewal sponsor. :thumbsup:

lena_support: One more note — customer asked whether quantized model variants would affect accuracy. Told them we'll test and share eval results tomorrow.

ryan_eng: ack, will include small eval run during canary and post summary.

maya_cs: Great. Last message is this — I'll compile notes and send to account owner. Thx y'all.
